messages:
maya_sales: Athena (prospect) wants a short POC to validate SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning (bulk + delta), RBAC, and domain ownership proof. They asked for a one-pager scope + ballpark pricing by EOD. Can you help scope? @lee_devx @omar_sec

lee_devx: Two POC options: Hosted quick-smoke (7 days) or Dedicated mini-reserve (14 days). Hosted covers SAML + SCIM basic flows; SCIM QPS limited. Dedicated gives higher SCIM throughput, longer log retention, and KMS options.

omar_sec: Security checklist to request: IdP metadata XML, desired NameID format, whether assertions must be signed/encrypted, cert rotation window, compliance regime (SOC2/ISO), and whether they require HSM-backed keys for key material. Note: HSM support adds legal/contract time on Private/Dedicated.

jen_eng: Engineering flags: if they plan >250k users we should plan bulk CSV import (S3) + delta webhook. For RBAC demo we need sample role->permission mapping and any delegated-admin flows. Domain proof is DNS TXT; automated recheck only on Dedicated.

infra-bot: Created ticket <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-31299> for infra estimate assigned to @jen_eng.

lee_devx: Draft one-pager bullets (will finalize): POC duration, deliverables (SAML config, SCIM full import + delta sync, RBAC mapping demo with 3 roles, domain verification steps, basic audit export), artifacts required from Athena (IdP metadata, roles CSV, domain TXT proof, expected user counts), and ballpark pricing.

maya_sales: Ballpark numbers? Need ranges to put in the deck.

lee_devx: Hosted 7-day POC: $3k-$6k. Dedicated 14-day mini-reserve: $10k-$18k (depends on reserved compute and log retention). Add-on: HSM/KMS integration + legal addendum if requested.

omar_sec: I'll draft the security Qs and HSM note; if they require per-user immutable audit trails, that's Private-level and will increase estimate.

maya_sales: Thanks all — I'll ask Athena for artifacts and send the one-pager when ready. Will update here once they reply. :white_check_mark:
